programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Film sekuel ini bercerita tentang imigran Yeh Feng yang kabur dari penjara untuk tinggal bersama paman Wang Sha yang jahat. Namun, ternyata kekasihnya, Ai Ti, telah menikah dengan seorang pria yang kasar.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli kung fu gaya monyet yang dikalahkan oleh seorang penjahat kejam diyakinkan oleh murid mudanya untuk mengajarinya kung fu gaya monyet demi membalas rasa malunya.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli kung fu gaya monyet yang dikalahkan oleh seorang penjahat kejam diyakinkan oleh murid mudanya untuk mengajarinya kung fu gaya monyet demi membalas rasa malunya.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Li Ching aktris terbaik di era nya berperan sebagai Ah Chiao adalah seorang gadis dari desa yang tersesat di kota, yang berteman dengan seorang pemondok yang baik hati dan seorang mantan aktor.

programme.title: Godfather Of Canton
programme.desc: Seorang komisaris ditangkap oleh utusan Cheng atas tuduhan korupsi dengan bantuan yang tak disengaja dari Lin. Saat bekerja untuk Cheng, Lin akhirnya mengetahui cara memperoleh uang suap dari Chang.

programme.title: The Blue And The Black
programme.desc: Berlatar pada masa kependudukan Jepang saat PD II, Tang Qi yang merupakan yatim piatu jatuh cinta dengan pemuda bernama Chang. Namun, cinta mereka dipenuhi tantangan, seperti tekanan keluarga hingga gejolak perang.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Seorang bandit dan penjudi keliling bekerja sama untuk menghasilkan uang dengan berjudi. Mereka ingin mencuri uang dari rumah seorang panglima, dan bertemu kelompok revolusioner yang mencari bantuan dana kampanye.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Aksi kepahlawanan dan kisah asmara mewarnai film seni bela diri klasik ini. Saat Shaolin dikhianati oleh Pertapa Alis Putih, Fong Sai Yuk sang prajurit pemarah bersumpah untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Film komedi romantis yang dibintangi artis legendaris Lin Feng Jiao ini menceritakan kisah cinta yang tak biasa antara putra seorang pengusaha dan keponakan perempuan dari seorang kepala sekolah taman kanak-kanak.

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: Sekawanan bandit brutal memperkosa dan menjarah di desa-desa Tiongkok. Liu Wen, ahli panah yang tengah berduka, beraksi bersama murid, anak, dan pelayannya guna membalas kematian istrinya dan mengembalikan kedamaian.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: Dua pemuda bergabung dengan kelompok pemberontak setelah Revolusi Tiongkok tahun 1911 dan tak sengaja menjadi pahlawan. Dibantu oleh seorang putri panglima perang, mereka berhasil membantu pemberontak mencuri senjata.

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Ksatria Pengembara menghadapi Guru Naga Rawa dalam perseteruan keluarga yang telah berlangsung selama 20 tahun. Dalam film aksi nan epik dan emosional ini, semua orang memperebutkan Pedang Naga Giok.

programme.title: Between Tears And Smiles
programme.desc: Kwan Shan harus menyelamatkan wanita yang ia cintai, sebelum wanita itu dipersembahkan sebagai hadiah untuk seorang Jenderal!

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: Film ini menampilkan bakat tari yang jarang terlihat dari pendekar wanita ternama, Cheng Pei-Pei, yang berperan sebagai salah satu dari tiga gadis yang berjuang mencapai puncak kepopuleran.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Setelah membunuh seekor harimau, Wu Sung mendapat kenaikan jabatan, namun ia malah terjebak dalam cinta segitiga yang tragis antara saudaranya yang buruk rupa dan istri saudaranya yang mencoba untuk menggodanya.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Seorang aktor berusaha meyakinkan sesosok wanita untuk berperan sebagai Samantha dalam film Bewitched yang dibuat ulang. Namun, ia tidak menyadari bila wanita itu ternyata benar-benar seorang penyihir!

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: Seorang polisi mengandalkan seorang pencuri mobil muda untuk menangkap empat gangster yang berencana merampok seorang pedagang kaya untuk mendapatkan sejumlah besar uang.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: Seorang mata-mata Tiongkok yang telah pensiun selama sepuluh tahun dan mencari nafkah sebagai tukang daging dikirim ke Hong Kong untuk menemukan tengkorak Tyrannosaurus rex yang dicuri.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Liang Pao-erh bergabung dengan Spinsters' Club yang riang ketika dia menemukan suaminya berselingkuh. Terlepas dari wajah bahagia yang ditampilkan oleh saudara perempuannya, di balik itu semua, masing-masing dari mereka diam-diam merindukan seorang pria dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun adalah seorang ahli bela diri terampil yang bertarung untuk membalas dendam atas kematian sang kekasih dengan bantuan dari seorang pemimpin geng pengemis.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: Satpam Lee Go ditugaskan untuk menjaga sebuah rumah saat pemiliknya pergi. Namun, serangkaian kesalahpahaman lucu terjadi.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: JJ/Shu Qi dan PI Lam mencuri dua plat USD100 yang dicuri di Hong Kong. Lam kehilangan mereka - tidak ada hadiah dari AS. Lam dan ketiga malaikat kecilnya mencoba mendapatkannya kembali di Seoul, begitu pula JJ. Banyak pertarungan.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi akan mewarisi kekayaan kakeknya yang tengah sekarat dengan satu syarat, yaitu ia harus menikah dalam waktu sebulan. Jika tidak, warisan tersebut akan diberikan kepada sang paman yang bernama Robert.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs dan Octopus menerima pekerjaan dari pemilik kontrakan mereka: menculik seorang bayi. Tak lama kemudian, bayi itu membangkitkan perasaan kebapakan yang kuat dalam diri kedua penjahat tersebut, yang menyebabkan komplikasi ketika mereka harus menyerahkan bayi itu kepada kakeknya yang mungkin seorang bos geng gila.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Bintang laga Chow Yun-Fat memerankan gangster sungguhan Chen Daqi saat ia naik ke eselon atas kekuasaan, mendapati dirinya terpecah antara cinta dua wanita, rencana pembunuhan dinas rahasia, dan ancaman perang yang membayangi.

programme.desc: Kisah pasutri milenial Zhao Xiaowu dan suaminya, perancang mainan yang enggan punya anak, yang kedatangan bocah sepuluh tahun bernama Dong Xing saat liburan musim panas dan memulai cerita menarik.

programme.title: Kucing Berkaki Tiga Yang Tak Terkalahkan
programme.desc: Keluarga pasca-80-an, Zhao Xiaowu dan Guan Jian, yang awalnya enggan memiliki anak, mendapati hidup mereka berubah penuh warna saat menerima Dong Xing, bocah 10 tahun penurut, untuk tinggal bersama selama liburan musim panas.

programme.title: Northern Borders
programme.desc: Northern Borders' mengisahkan tentang Austen Kittredge yang berusia sepuluh tahun, yang dikirim oleh ayahnya untuk tinggal di pertanian kakek-neneknya di Vermont. Di sana, ia mengalami petualangan liar dan mengungkap rahasia keluarga yang telah lama terpendam. Ceritanya berlatar tahun 1956, dan Austen merasakan pertanian itu sebagai tempat yang penuh dengan orang-orang eksentrik, terutama kakek-neneknya yang keras kepala, yang pernikahan mereka yang penuh masalah dikenal sebagai Perang Empat Puluh Tahun. Awalnya merasa terjebak di rumah tangga yang retak ini, Austen muda berencana untuk segera pergi, tetapi akhirnya terdampar tanpa pilihan selain beradaptasi dan bertahan. Sebuah kisah pendewasaan yang lucu dan terkadang mengejutkan, 'Northern Borders' membangkitkan nuansa liar Vermont, keindahannya yang luar biasa, masa lalu yang kelam, dan aura pesona.

programme.title: Rumors Of Wars
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar menulis jurnal ketika pemerintahan dunia tunggal mengambil alih dunia. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, seorang tentara menemukan jurnal tersebut dan mulai mempertanyakan segala sesuatu yang selama ini diyakininya.

programme.title: Image

programme.title: Mike Says Goodbye
programme.desc: Setelah pulih dari leukemia, Mike yang berusia 10 tahun siap meninggalkan rumah sakit, tetapi ibunya tidak pernah datang untuk membawanya pulang.

programme.title: First Snow
programme.desc: First Snow mengisahkan Jimmy Starks, seorang tenaga penjual yang hidupnya berubah drastis setelah seorang peramal meramalkan bahwa ia akan meninggal saat salju pertama turun. Semakin banyak ramalan yang terbukti benar, Jimmy mulai terjebak dalam ketakutan, paranoia, dan obsesi untuk menghindari takdirnya. Upayanya mengubah masa depan justru membawanya pada serangkaian peristiwa menegangkan yang menguji kewarasannya serta hubungannya dengan orang-orang di sekitarnya.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lunatic
programme.desc: Nama saya Trew; ini adalah kisah tentang bagaimana saya dikunjungi oleh Yang Mahakuasa dan Dia meminta saya untuk menuliskan semua yang Dia katakan. Sederhana saja, Dia berbicara, saya panik, hal yang luar biasa terjadi.

programme.title: 24 Hours With Megan Thee...
programme.desc: Mengabadikan perjalanan Megan Thee Stallion menuju ketenaran, mengarungi ketenaran, duka, dan kesuksesan. Film ini menawarkan akses tak tertandingi kepada sang seniman multifaset, mengungkap momen-momen rentannya, dan memungkinkan kita bertemu dengan Megan Pete yang sesungguhnya di balik persona tersebut.

programme.title: Wedding Planner Mystery
programme.desc: Perencana pernikahan itu merencanakan 2 pernikahan untuk keluarga kaya yang sama dengan selang waktu 2 minggu. Ia juga dikejar oleh seorang pengacara dan seorang reporter. Namun kemudian terjadi dugaan pembunuhan yang diikuti oleh upaya pembunuhan lainnya. Masalah-masalah lain pun muncul. Ia pun melakukan penyelidikan.

programme.title: Taking Earth
programme.desc: Umat ​​manusia terjerumus ke dalam kekacauan ketika invasi alien menguasai planet ini dalam upaya untuk menemukan satu anak laki-laki di antara 7 miliar orang yang memiliki kekuatan untuk menghancurkan mereka.

programme.title: Midway To Heaven
programme.desc: Sudah bertahun-tahun sejak Ned Stevens, seorang pria menawan yang sukses berkat kerja kerasnya sendiri, kehilangan istrinya, Kate, karena kanker. Namun, ia masih belum bisa melupakan kenangan tentang istrinya dan melanjutkan hidupnya. Tetapi ketika Liz membawa pulang pacar baru dari kampus, Ned mendapati dunianya yang nyaman terbalik ketika Liz mencoba mengalihkan perhatiannya kepada Carol, seorang wanita lajang menarik yang tinggal di lingkungan Ned.

programme.desc: Meral (8) baru saja pindah ke sebuah kota baru. Ia berusaha mendapatkan teman di sekolah barunya sebelum perkemahan musim gugur sekolah dimulai, tetapi ternyata hal itu lebih sulit dari yang dibayangkannya. Di rumah, ia berteman dengan seekor tikus kecil yang tinggal di kamar barunya, yang ia beri nama Peepeep. Takut orang tuanya akan membunuh Peepeep saat ia pergi, Meral diam-diam membawanya ikut serta. Berkat tikus kecil itu, Meral mendapatkan beberapa teman baru yang tak terduga. Ketika seekor burung hantu menangkap tikus kecil tersebut, Meral menyalahkan teman-teman barunya. Baru setelah mereka bersama-sama pergi ke alam liar untuk mencari muntahan burung hantu yang berisi tulang-belulang Peepeep, Meral akhirnya memahami arti sebenarnya dari persahabatan. programme.title: Konspirasi Rasa Penuh Tanya

programme.title: Dipuji Tidak Terbang, Dicintaimu Aku Gass Bang
programme.desc: Nada sudah pacaran dengan sesama dokter, namanya Bayu, teman kuliah dulu. Saat Nada mau mengajak Bayu makan siang. Nada ke ruangan Bayu dan malah melihat bayu selingkuh dengan temannya di rumah sakit. Ingin move on dan cepat melupakan Bayu, Nada mengajukan diri untuk di pindah tugasnya. Ada anak-anak desa yang kebetulan main di sana. Nada minta tolong kepada mereka. Untuk memanggilkan kepala desanya. Harusnya kepala desa menjemput dia. Tapi mereka malah memanggil Samson. Samson sebenarnya memang diminta kepala desa, untuk menjemput dokter yang akan bertugas di puskesmas mereka.

programme.title: Hilang Untuk Kembali
programme.desc: Demi merebut kembali tanah yang diambil oleh sahabat Ayahnya, Erin nekat pergi ke Bali mencari teman Ayahnya tersebut. Sesampainya disana Erin ditabrak sebuah mobil yang ternyata adalah sahabat Ayahnya yang ia cari. Erin pun menggunakan kesempatan itu dengan sebaik-baiknya sehingga ia bisa tinggal bersama Pak Hutomo. Namun niat merebut kembali surat tanah Ayahnya tersebut, Erin justru jatuh cinta dengan anak Pak Hutomo yang bernama Bagas.

Sementara Dito (Vicky Kalea) hadir membantu Cinta dengan tulus. Saat perselingkuhan terbongkar, Cinta memilih bangkit demi diri dan anaknya.

programme.title: Sang Pencuri Hati Di Arena Balap

Mita menduga pencurinya adalah Kemal (Fauzan Nasrul). Namun, Kemal melakukan hal tersebut karena suatu hal. Kemal ingat bahwa Mita adalah cinta pertamanya saat kecil. Mita yang murka tidak mau mendengarkan penjelasan Kemal.

programme.desc: ada seorang gadis cantik bernama Mila yang disukai oleh beberapa orang pria tapi wanita muda tersebut menolaknya. Mila membuat patah hati para pria karena ia memilih untuk berpacaran dengan Arga, pria populer di sekolahnya. Beberapa tahun kemudian, anak-anak SMA itu reuni di sebuah villa tua. Hadir di sana beberapa orang yang terkenal saat SMA. Mereka adalah Mila Arga Dona, dan beberapa orang lainnya. Orang-orang yang berada di sana, menuduh Arga menjadi dalang di balik meninggalnya Mila tersebut.

programme.title: WCCB: Fundora Vs Thurman
programme.desc: WCCB: Fundora vs Thurman menghadirkan pertarungan tinju bergengsi antara petinju bertangan kidal bertubuh tinggi Sebastian Fundora dan mantan juara dunia Keith Thurman. Fundora mengandalkan jangkauan panjang, tekanan tanpa henti, dan pukulan ke tubuh, sementara Thurman membawa kekuatan pukulan eksplosif, kecerdasan bertarung, dan pengalaman juara. Duel ini menjadi pertarungan strategi antara energi muda dan pengalaman dalam divisi welter.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Mosley Vs Floyd
programme.desc: Acara utama dalam episode ini adalah pertarungan kelas welter yang sangat dinanti-nantikan yang menampilkan Floyd Mayweather, Jr. dan "Sugar" Shane Mosley. Pertarungan yang menghasilkan pendapatan sebesar $78 juta ini merupakan perebutan gelar pertama bagi Mayweather sejak ia kembali dari masa pensiunnya yang pertama. Juga ada dalam kartu pertandingan, petinju kelas berat Bermane Stiverne dan juara dunia dua divisi Marcos Maidana.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo S11, Ep 2

programme.title: Bipolar Rock N' Roller S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: Kisah nyata dan tak tergoyahkan tentang perjuangan Mauro Ranallo selama puluhan tahun melawan Gangguan Afektif Bipolar. Sebagai pengisi suara WWE dan Showtime Championship Boxing, Ranallo telah mengisi beberapa acara olahraga terbesar dalam sejarah - sembari bertarung dalam pertarungan epiknya dengan kesehatan mentalnya sendiri. Ikuti perjalanannya dalam serial 3 bagian ini, saat ia melawan stigma di balik masalah kesehatan mental dan menyoroti bagaimana rasanya menjadi yang teratas dalam industri ini meskipun rintangan yang tampaknya tidak dapat diatasi. Disutradarai oleh Haris Usanovic dengan penampilan dari Floyd Mayweather Jr. dan Conor McGregor. Episode 3 dari 3.

Dalam episode ini, kita melihat yang terbaik dari Grand Slam Judo dari Baku dan petarung peringkat dua dunia, Michael Korrell, berbicara tentang judo.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: Di Barat yang tak ada aturan hukum, The Cowboys, kakak-beradik pembunuh dan pencuri nan terkenal, menguasai wilayah tersebut dengan tinju brutal dan senjata api. Namun, takdir akhirnya datang menghampiri mereka.

programme.title: Don't Suck
programme.desc: Kesempatan terakhir seorang komedian veteran untuk menjadi bintang membawanya ke jalan bersama seorang komedian muda yang mengungkap masa lalu yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: Seorang pengacara muda yang sederhana memimpin sebuah perang melawan pasukan Nazi menjelang akhir dari Perang Dunia II.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Seorang perawat asal Inggris lolos dari serangan di pos terdepan. Saat ia diburu oleh kelompok yang dipimpin Jerman, ia memulai perjalanan epik demi menyelamatkan pos terdekat dengan bantuan dari pejuang setempat.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Polisi Jack Stone merampok bank mafia Rusia dan berakhir di penjara yang sama dengan bos mafia yang membunuh istri Jack. Seorang narapidana membantunya dan begitu pula seorang reporter. Banyak perkelahian.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: Sebuah unit yang terdiri dari orang-orang dengan berbagai karakter aneh yang dikenal sebagai War Pigs harus maju ke garis perang untuk memusnahkan Nazi dengan segala cara.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: Setelah kematian ayahnya, Tim Webber kembali ke desa asalnya di Sommerset dan menemukan sesuatu nan mengerikan yang mengganggu ketenangan desanya.

programme.title: The Junkyard Dogs
programme.desc: Mengikuti seekor anjing yang merupakan ahli melarikan diri, yang harus bekerja sama dengan teman-teman anak anjingnya untuk mencegah blok mereka dirampok.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: Seorang petani menampung seorang pria yang terluka dengan tas berisi uang tunai. Ketika sekelompok orang datang untuk mengambil uang itu, dia harus memutuskan siapa yang bisa dipercaya. Saat mempertahankan diri dari pengepungan, dia mengungkapkan bakatnya sebagai penembak jitu yang membuat identitas aslinya dipertanyakan.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: Angkatan Laut Jerman dan kapal-kapal U-Boat yang tersisa bergabung untuk satu misi terakhir guna menyerang Amerika Serikat.

programme.title: Envy
programme.desc: Seorang pria menjadi semakin iri terhadap kesuksesan yang baru diraih temannya.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Mexico
The Angry Birds Movie 2
programme.desc: Saat sebuah ancaman nan membahayakan muncul, Red, Chuck, Bomb, dan Mighty Eagle merekrut saudara Chuck dan bekerja sama dengan para babi untuk melakukan gencatan senjata demi menyelamatkan rumah mereka.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Seorang siswa pemalu, seorang pria bersenjata dan sepasang kakak-beradik bekerja sama dalam melawan zombie yang mewabah di Amerika.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Seorang siswa pemalu, seorang pria bersenjata dan sepasang kakak-beradik bekerja sama dalam melawan zombie yang mewabah di Amerika.

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programme.desc: Columbus, Tallahassee, Wichita, dan Little Rock pindah ke jantung Amerika saat mereka menghadapi segerombolan zombie yang berevolusi, sesama penyintas, dan kekacauan dalam keluarga mereka.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Dua siswa SMA harus mengatasi kegelisahan mereka akan perpisahan setelah rencana mereka untuk mengadakan sebuah pesta berakhir berantakan.

programme.title: 30 Days Of Night
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kota di Alaska diliputi kegelapan selama sebulan, kota itu diserang oleh sekelompok vampir haus darah.

programme.title: Passengers
programme.desc: Kerusakan pada satu kapsul tidur di sebuah pesawat menuju sebuah planet koloni nan jauh membangunkan seorang penumpang 90 tahun lebih awal.

programme.title: Life
programme.desc: Sebuah tim ilmuwan yang tiba di Stasiun Luar Angkasa Internasional menemukan kehidupan nan berkembang pesat yang menyebabkan kepunahan di Mars dan kini mengancam kehidupan semua makhluk di muka Bumi.

programme.title: Ultraviolet (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Seorang hemofag cantik yang terinfeksi virus yang memberinya kekuatan super harus melindungi seorang anak laki-laki di dunia futuristik, yang diduga membawa antigen yang akan menghancurkan semua hemofag.

programme.title: Testament Of Youth
programme.desc: Seorang wanita Inggris mengenang masa dewasanya selama Perang Dunia I - sebuah kisah tentang cinta muda, kesia-siaan perang, dan bagaimana memahami masa-masa tergelap.

programme.title: Slender Man (Galaxy Premium)

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 18
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul
programme.desc: Bedu dan Adul adalah sebuah serial film animasi 3D tentang petualangan anak-anak di kawasan pinggiran Jakarta.

programme.title: Detektif Kubi
programme.desc: Rasa ingin tahu mendorong orang untuk belajar! Baru-baru ini, di Hutan Sinar Matahari, banyak hal aneh telah terjadi. Jadi orang-orang meminta bantuan Detektif Kubi. Detektif Kubi, bersama dengan teman-teman mudanya, menemukan petunjuk dalam permainan kata dan membantu teman-teman mereka di hutan untuk memecahkan kasus satu per satu.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: Tian Tian
programme.desc: Tian Tian

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: Cipung Abubu
programme.desc: Cipung Abubu

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. Bersama para boba, makhluk yang bekerja di sana, mereka menciptakan alatalat ajaib hingga bertemu berbagai makhluk menakjubkan seperti monster tauge, para virus, zombie, manusia salju, hingga bertemu supercool yang meningkatkan adrenalin petualangan mereka.

Setelah berhasil menaklukkan liga pokemon di wilayah sebelumnya, ash memutuskan untuk mencari tantangan baru dan memperluas cakrawala petualangannya. Di wilayah baru ini, ash bertemu dengan para pelatih pokemon baru, termasuk karakter-karakter yang bersemangat untuk menguji kekuatan tim mereka. Sambil menghadapi berbagai tantangan, ash dan teman-temannya juga belajar tentang pokemon baru yang belum pernah mereka temui sebelumnya, serta bentuk budaya dan kehidupan baru di wilayah tersebut. Namun, petualangan mereka tidaklah mudah. Mereka harus menghadapi ancaman baru, termasuk organisasi jahat yang berusaha memanfaatkan kekuatan pokemon untuk tujuan mereka sendiri.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Kompilasi perjalanan cinta Aldebaran dan Andin yang penuh lika-liku, mulai dari kesalahpahaman, pengorbanan, hingga perjuangan mempertahankan keluarga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta (RCTI)
programme.desc: Usai kecelakaan yang merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap jalanan. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi cinta, hingga rahasia adopsi dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Terikat Janji (RCTI)
programme.desc: Davina terluka karena pengkhianatan cinta dan hidupnya hancur. Ia kemudian menjalin hubungan pura-pura dengan Sena. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keduanya benar-benar jatuh cinta, namun harus menghadapi rahasia dan konflik keluarga yang rumit.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Terbaik Itu Kamu (RCTI)
programme.desc: Sera harus menanggung kesalahan yang tidak pernah ia perbuat, sementara Kenzi menyimpan rasa bersalah atas kejadian yang mengubah hidup Sera. Saat kebenaran mulai terungkap, apakah semuanya masih bisa diperbaiki?

programme.title: Microdrama + : Mendadak Cinta
programme.desc: Gavin, pengusaha muda, yang muak dijodohkan, menemukan cinta pada Vior, gadis desa sederhana yang ternyata seorang artis dengan skandal pelakor. Demi membuktikan ketulusan Vior, Gavin harus mempertaruhkan bisnis dan masa depannya.

programme.title: Mendadak Cinta
programme.desc: Gavin, pengusaha muda yang kabur dari tekanan keluarga, menemukan cinta tak terduga dengan Vior, gadis desa yang menyimpan rahasia masa lalu. Saat rahasia terungkap, hubungan mereka diuji oleh gosip dan prasangka.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Anugerah Cinta (Rr)
programme.desc: Ayah Naura meninggalkan beban utang bagi keluarganya, yang membuat Naura dan Oki pergi ke Jakarta untuk mencari uang. Di sana, Naura bertemu dengan Arka dan mereka pun jatuh cinta, hingga akhirnya hadir orang ketiga dalam hubungan mereka.

programme.title: Anugerah Cinta
programme.desc: Suhari menyuruh Naura dan Oki ke Jakarta untuk bertemu Hutomo, temannya. Karena Bang Jaja memaksa menikah dengan Naura. Bang Jaja membunuh Suhari, Naura dan Oki belum mendapatkan alamat Hutomo. Di Jakarta Naura bertemu dengan Arka yang sebenarnya anaknya Hutomo. Naura dan Oki tinggal dirumah Arka. Namun disana, Vina dan Tiara, ibu dan adiknya Arka amat membenci Naura. Arka pun dijodohkan dengan Kinta oleh Vina.

programme.title: Healing Jalur King Nassar
programme.desc: “Healing Jalur King Nassar” is not just about sharing stories; it also invites participants to rediscover their zest for life through music, interaction, games, and even a “healing recipe” before heading home.

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang dua bersaudara, Andin (kakak) dan Elsa (adik). Tanpa mereka sadari mencintai pria yang sama, Nino. Hubungan mereka yang buruk menjadi lebih buruk ketika Elsa tahu bahwa Nino akan menikahi Andin. Pernikahan Nino dan Andin mendapat dukungan sang ayah, namun ditentang oleh sang ibu.

programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda dan Indy adalah kakak beradik yang saling menyayangi. Ibu mereka, Rianty, meninggal saat melahirkan Indy. Sejak saat itu, Manda dan Indy hanya hidup bertiga bersama ayahnya, Indra. Manda berperan sebagai ibu bagi Indy. Suatu ketika ayah mereka mulai sakit sakitan dan masuk rumah sakit. Ternyata Indra mengidap leukemia.

programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Ketika kehilangan mengubah segalanya, Luna harus bangkit, menemukan kembali harapannya dan menghadapi pertemuan yang tak pernah ia duga. Akankah pertemuan itu menjadi awal dari kebahagiaan atau justru membawa luka yang lebih besar?

programme.title: Terikat Janji
programme.desc: kisah cinta yang rumit, penuh intrik, dan pengkhianatan yang mengguncang, Terikat Janji

programme.title: Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Satu pengkhianatan mengubah hidup selamanya, 5 tahun mendekam di penjara. Sekarang dia kembali dengan identitas baru, namun kebenaran tak mudah digenggam.

programme.title: Radio
programme.desc: Cerita tentang seorang kriminal yang terbiasa menerima kekerasan fisik dan non fisik sejak lahir untuk melindungi seorang yang disayangi. Kasih sayang membutakan akal sehatnya, hingga membuat dirinya menjadi pembunuh berdarah dingin.

programme.title: Barun Rai & The House On Cliff
programme.desc: Pasangan pengantin baru Soumili dan Harmesh Banerjee baru saja pindah ke rumah impian mereka, dan hidup mereka seharusnya sempurna. Namun, cinta mereka diuji oleh serangkaian kejadian misterius. Di sinilah Barun Rai muncul, karena keahliannya memang terletak pada penyelesaian kasus-kasus paranormal.

programme.title: Housefull 3
programme.desc: Seorang ayah tidak ingin ketiga putrinya menikah. Sekarang, terserah tiga pria untuk mencoba dan meyakinkan sang ayah bahwa mereka cocok untuk putrinya.

programme.desc: Seorang pria yang berasal dari keluarga sederhana berhasil meraih posisi yang berpengaruh dalam organisasi kejahatan. Tidak ada yang mampu menghentikannya sampai dia bertemu dengan petugas polisi yang menjalankan tugas untuk menegakkan keadilan dengan serius.

programme.title: Phata Poster Nikla Hero
programme.desc: Vishwas ingin menjadi aktor, tapi ibunya menginginkannya untuk menjadi polisi. Saat ia berdandan bak seorang polisi guna melakukan pemotretan, seorang pekerja sosial, Kajal, mengiranya sebagai polisi sungguhan.

programme.title: Uunchai

programme.title: Undercover Brother
programme.desc: Life has changed drastically for thunder buddies John (Mark Wahlberg), now a bachelor, and best pal Ted (Seth MacFarlane), now married to the woman (Jessica Barth) of his dreams. Problems arise when the couple decide to adopt a child, but the law declares Ted to be property and not a person. Angry and dejected, the lovably foulmouthed teddy bear must now seek legal help from a young lawyer (Amanda Seyfried) and a legendary, civil-rights attorney (Morgan Freeman) to get the justice he deserves.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.desc: At a village where only women live, a demon that was sealed away in a hanging scroll at Kanondo is revived. The demon merges with his main body, which had sunk to the bottom of the river, and shows his true form, a salamander demon.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Swarmed
programme.desc: The residents of a small town find themselves battling a swarm of hornets that have been sprayed by a super pesticide.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Manos: The Hands Of Fate
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to elevate the material by hosting Manos as if it were an episode of Masterpiece Theater.

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

programme.title: Fade To Black [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

programme.title: Living Dark: The Story of Ted the Caver
programme.desc: Two estranged brothers become obsessed with gaining access to an unexplored cave, despite the horrors they encounter during their excavation.

programme.title: Spiders 2
programme.desc: Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: On a trip to Colombia, a group of college students heads into the rainforest to look for cave drawings. Instead, they find a 50-foot boa constrictor.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: Hell Night
programme.desc: Four college pledges are forced to spend the night in a deserted old mansion, where they are stalked by the monstrous survivor of a family massacre years earlier.

programme.title: Body Bags [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A creepy-looking coroner (John Carpenter) introduces three different horror tales involving his current work which are cadavers in "body bags."

programme.title: Flight 666
programme.desc: Passengers on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces. As they fight to stay alive, they realize who is controlling the attacks.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: House of Bones
programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.title: Alligator II: The Mutation
programme.desc: A police detective (Joseph Bologna) teams up with a Cajun hunter (Richard Lynch) to find a giant killer-reptile in the city sewers.

programme.title: Alligator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats injected with growth hormones.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Apollo 18
programme.desc: Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. The men also discover a dead cosmonaut, and unfortunately for them, learn how he died.

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn't give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What's that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS

programme.title: Sabrina, the Animated Series
programme.desc: Gem and Sabrina are teamed up to work on a book report. Since they can never agree on anything - they argue over who will start reading. programme.desc: This cartoon for preschoolers takes two elements young children often find fascinating -- mythical animals and monster trucks -- and combines them to create a different kind of action hero. The mechanicals are comprised of Rex, Unicorn, Komodo, Sasquatch and Mouse, five friends with the power to transform themselves into various shapes, which comes in handy considering the world in which they inhabit is also a "snap-together-take-apart" kind of place.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Host of Curiosity Quest, Joel Greene gets an all access pass to one of the largest helicopter manufacturers to learn how helicopters are made. programme.desc: In early 19th-century Canada, orphaned sisters Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins) find themselves lost in a forest while riding on horseback. They're rescued by The Hunter (Nathaniel Arcand), a mysterious Native American who takes them back to Fort Bailey. Something strange has happened there, however. The few settlers who remain are suspicious of outsiders and keep tight-lipped about the situation, but Ginger soon discovers their secret for herself.

programme.desc: Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. No one feels the uproar more than Reginald (Tom Courtenay), Jean's ex-husband, who still stings from her long-ago infidelity. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice.

When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes).

programme.desc: When rookie cop Megan Turner (Jamie Lee Curtis) kills a convenience store robber, she does not notice when psychopathic commodities trader Eugene Hunt (Ron Silver) takes the dead man's gun. With no weapon at the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. Meanwhile, Hunt uses the stolen weapon to go on a killing spree. Turner teams up with detective Nick Mann (Clancy Brown) to clear her name and catch the killer. An unexpected romance complicates matters.

Helena Douglas (Sarah Carter) is an athlete with a tragic past. Christie Allen (Holly Valance) earns her keep as a thief and an assassin-for-hire.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty

With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

programme.title: H. H. Holmes: America's First Serial Killer
programme.desc: This chilling documentary follows the macabre exploits of 19th-century serial killer Herman Webster Mudgett, who went by the alias of Dr. Henry Howard Holmes. A remarkably effective con artist and liar, Holmes managed to construct a massive building in Chicago where he operated a labyrinthine hotel for his intended victims. The film features footage of key locations in the life of Holmes, as well as interviews with experts and dramatic reenactments.

programme.title: A Rough Draft
programme.desc: A video game designer is stripped of his identity and recruited by a mysterious force to be the gatekeeper of a multi-dimensional portal.

programme.title: Forty Winks
programme.desc: A struggling hypnotist in New York city is blackmailed into being the world's first hypnotist hitman after a mysterious woman finds out his degree is fake.

programme.title: Amber Road

programme.title: Murder Loves Killers Too
programme.desc: A deranged man, whose version of sex is murdering people, hunts after a group of sexy teenagers.

programme.title: All Superheroes Must Die

programme.title: How to Eat Your Watermelon in White Company (and Enjoy It)
programme.desc: Melvin Van Peebles was one of the first black directors to challenge the white establishment in his films, which include "Watermelon Man" and "Sweet Sweetback's Baadasssss Song." In this documentary, the life of Van Peebles is discussed, including his work not only in film, but also as a novelist, actor, musician, stock trader and even Air Force pilot. Interview subjects include Gil Scott-Heron, Spike Lee and Melvin's son and fellow filmmaker, Mario Van Peebles.

programme.title: Decade of Fire
programme.desc: In the 1970s, fires consumed the South Bronx. Black and Puerto Rican residents were blamed, even as they fought to save their homes. Vivian Vázquez Irizarry pursues the truth around the fires, uncovering racist policies and neglect that shape our cities.

programme.title: Upstairs Inferno
programme.desc: For over 40 years, the 1973 New Orleans gay bar arson was considered the "Largest Gay Mass Murder in US History." Featuring heart-wrenching interviews with survivors, friends of victims, and witnesses, the film vividly examines the forgotten tragedy.

programme.title: Insert Coin
programme.desc: The untold story of how Mortal Kombat, NBA Jam, and other arcade classics were created by a ragtag crew in the back of a Chicago factory. Generating billions of dollars, they rode the wave of the booming 90s arcade scene... until a new enemy appears.

programme.title: The Illegal

programme.title: The Cran
programme.desc: After a comedian runs into his ex at an open mic, the two become complicit in an absurd revenge crusade that puts them in the crosshairs of a rural cult in Cranwell County.

programme.title: The Taqwacores

programme.title: Judge Not

programme.title: City on Fire
programme.desc: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves, but things go terribly wrong during a heist.

programme.title: Rough Magic
programme.desc: In the midst of a dazzling stage show, magician's assistant Myra Shumway (Bridget Fonda) catches the eye of sleazy industrialist Cliff Wyatt (D.W. Moffett). When Wyatt unwittingly kills Shumway's mentor, a master magician, she flees to Mexico. Furious, Wyatt hires private detective Alex Ross (Russell Crowe) to capture the gorgeous witness to his crime. But, after Ross locates Shumway, he finds himself beguiled by her growing prowess as a magician -- and by the potency of her feminine charms.

programme.title: Slacker
programme.desc: Austin, Texas, is an Eden for the young and unambitious, from the enthusiastically eccentric to the dangerously apathetic. Here, the nobly lazy can eschew responsibility in favor of nursing their esoteric obsessions. The locals include a backseat philosopher (Richard Linklater) who passionately expounds on his dream theories to a seemingly comatose cabbie (Rudy Basquez), a young woman who tries to hawk Madonna's Pap test to anyone who will listen and a kindly old anarchist looking for recruits.

programme.title: Nosferatu the Vampyre
programme.desc: Jonathan Harker is sent away to Count Dracula's castle to sell him a house in Virna, where he lives. But Count Dracula is a vampire, an undead ghoul living off men's blood. Inspired by a photograph of Lucy Harker, Jonathan's wife, Dracula moves to Virna, bringing with him death and plague... An unusually contemplative version of Dracula, in which the vampire bears the cross of not being able to get old and die.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Chinese martial arts student Chen Zhen is studying in Kyoto, Japan, when he learns his mentor has died in a match against Ryuichi Akutagawa. Returning home to the Japanese-occupied Shanghai of 1937, Chen challenges Ryuichi to a fight and easily defeats him. Concluding his master was set up, Chen has an autopsy performed. Meanwhile, word of his martial arts skill entices new students hoping to study with him, making his teacher's son, Huo Ting-An, jealous.

programme.title: Fast Vengeance
programme.desc: Determined to find those responsible for his brother's death, a man infiltrates the dangerous and high-stakes world of underground motorcycle racing.

programme.title: Take Back

programme.title: College

But in college his uptight attitude doesn't win him any points with his sports-loving classmates, and pretty coed Mary (Anne Cornwall) ignores him in favor of brutish jock Jeff (Harold Goodwin). Hoping to impress Mary, Ronald makes a buffoon of himself at every sport imaginable, usually at Jeff's hand. But Ronald gets a final shot at glory in a big rowing race.

Sentenced to three years in prison, Yiu is "fresh meat" for the hardened criminals and triad stooges that run things, and is preyed upon by sadistic guard Scarface (Roy Cheung). The virtuous Ching (Chow Yun-Fat) intervenes, teaching him the ropes of prison life, and a tender friendship develops between the two.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 2: Rise of a Warrior
programme.desc: After a swarm of enchanted scorpions kills his father, Mathayus (Michael Copon) flees and vows to even the score with ruthless sorcerer Sargon (Randy Couture). Upon returning home after years of combat training, Mathayus finds that Sargon has seized the crown and protected himself with a powerful spell. To retrieve the only weapon capable of destroying the tyrant -- a mystical sword -- Mathayus and lady warrior Layla (Karen David) set off for a labyrinth guarded by a deadly Minotaur.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power
programme.desc: Mathayus is framed for the murder of the king of Norvania, and he and his allies have to stop the evil heir from finding a mythical power.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Eric Bana ("Black Hawk Down") stars as scientist Bruce Banner, whose inner demons transform him in the aftermath of a catastrophic experiment; Jennifer Connelly portrays Betty Ross, whose scientific genius unwittingly helps unleash the Hulk; Nick Nolte plays Banner's brilliant father, who passes on a tragic legacy to his son; and Sam Elliott portrays the commander of a top-secret military research center.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: In this action-comedy, unusual circumstances find big, brawny cop John Kimble (Arnold Schwarzenegger) posing as a kindergarten teacher in order to apprehend major drug lord Cullen Crisp (Richard Tyson), as well as his ruthless accomplice and mother, Eleanor (Carroll Baker). While pretending to be a kid-friendly instructor, Kimble falls for pretty fellow teacher Joyce Palmieri (Penelope Ann Miller) as he battles both unruly children and dangerous bad guys.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: Thunderbirds
programme.desc: Former astronaut Jeff Tracy (Bill Paxton) runs International Rescue, a top-secret heroic organization, from his headquarters on Tracy Island. The island also houses the futuristic vehicles created by Ray "Brains" Hackenbacker (Anthony Edwards). But while Jeff is on a mission in space, his nemesis, The Hood (Ben Kingsley), invades Tracy Island. The Hood plots to use the island's technology for evil, and only Jeff's son, Alan (Brady Corbet), can stop him.

programme.title: Undercover Brother
programme.desc: Blasted from the past and ready to take care of business, "Undercover Brother" is recruited to infiltrate a sinister underground movement headed by The Man. Partnered with the sassy, stunning Sistah Girl, our hero must first undergo the ultimate attitude adjustment and trade in his 'fro and platforms for tennis sweaters and penny loafers. Once the transformation is complete, he's ready to take on the evil perpetrators of Operation Whitewash.

programme.title: Alpha Dog
programme.desc: Teenage dealer Johnny Truelove (Emile Hirsch) and his friends kidnap the impressionable younger brother (Anton Yelchin) of a junkie (Ben Foster) who refuses to pay his drug debt. Things change unexpectedly when Frankie (Justin Timberlake), one of Johnny's pals, befriends the youth.

programme.title: Chinese Zodiac
programme.desc: A treasure hunter (Jackie Chan) and his team set out on a global quest to find a set of Chinese zodiac bronze heads that were stolen from a Beijing palace in the 19th century.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Firefighters Vince (Bill Paxton) and Don (William Sadler) venture into gang-infested territory to find gold that's been hidden inside an abandoned building. But when they witness a murder, they become the targets of crime lord King James (Ice-T) and his underling Savon (Ice Cube). Fortunately, the treasure hunters have kidnapped a bargaining chip: King James' half-brother, Lucky (Devoreaux White). But this might not be enough to get them -- and their gold -- out of the building intact.

programme.title: Smokin' Aces
programme.desc: Sleazy entertainer Buddy "Aces" Israel incurs the wrath of crime boss Primo Sparazza when he agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob. Two FBI agents have the difficult task of protecting him from a motley assortment of bounty hunters, hit men and nefarious vixens who are converging on his Lake Tahoe encampment to rub him out and collect a hefty reward.

programme.title: The Frighteners
programme.desc: Once an architect, Frank Bannister (Michael J. Fox) now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives. As he tries to piece together the supernatural mystery of these killings, he falls in love with the wife (Trini Alvarado) of one of the victims and deals with a crazy FBI agent (Jeffrey Combs).

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: On an Arctic expedition, Stanley Shepard discovers Charlie, a Neanderthal man frozen in ice. With a team of scientists, Shepard revives Charlie and learns that he has been cryogenically suspended for 40,000 years. Stanley grows close to Charlie as he observes the man and learns about his prehistoric culture -- but when the media catches on to the discovery, Stanley must protect Charlie from fellow scientists who want to use his corpse for scientific research.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: The Andromeda Strain
programme.desc: Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. A group of top scientists are hurriedly assembled in a bid to identify and contain the lethal stowaway. Based on the novel by Michael Crichton.

programme.title: Junior
programme.desc: A research scientist becomes the world's first pregnant man in order to test a drug he and a colleague have designed for expectant women. To carry out the trial, he has an embryo implant, believing that he will only carry the baby for three months - hardly expecting to face the prospect of giving birth.

programme.title: Twins
programme.desc: The products of a genetic experiment, fraternal twins Julius (Arnold Schwarzenegger) and Vincent (Danny DeVito) are separated at birth. Their mother, Mary Ann (Bonnie Bartlett), is told they're dead. Now Vincent, an unscrupulous street hustler, ekes out a living in Los Angeles. Julius, raised by a scientist (Tony Jay), grows up humble, intelligent and strong, but very naive about the larger world. When Julius learns of his mother and brother, he heads to Los Angeles to find his family.

programme.title: Bird on a Wire
programme.desc: Rick Jarmin (Mel Gibson) is put in witness protection after he helps the FBI bust drug dealer Eugene Sorenson (David Carradine). Fifteen years later, he is living with a new identity as a gas station attendant in Detroit. When an old flame named Marianne (Goldie Hawn) stops at the gas station and recognizes him, his cover gets blown. The recently released Sorenson finds out, and both Jarmin and Marianne have to flee across the country with the vengeful Sorenson in hot pursuit.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: New York concierge Doug Ireland (Michael J. Fox) wants to go into business for himself and refurbish a hotel on Roosevelt Island, N.Y., but he needs an investor. With a few weeks left before his option on the site runs out, Doug agrees to help wealthy Christian Hanover (Anthony Higgins) conceal his affair with salesgirl Andy Hart (Gabrielle Anwar) from his wife. Despite his own attraction to Andy, Doug tries to stay focused on getting Christian to invest $3 million in his project.

programme.title: Ted 2
programme.desc: Life has changed drastically for thunder buddies John (Mark Wahlberg), now a bachelor, and best pal Ted (Seth MacFarlane), now married to the woman (Jessica Barth) of his dreams. Problems arise when the couple decide to adopt a child, but the law declares Ted to be property and not a person. Angry and dejected, the lovably foulmouthed teddy bear must now seek legal help from a young lawyer (Amanda Seyfried) and a legendary, civil-rights attorney (Morgan Freeman) to get the justice he deserves.

programme.title: A Million Ways to Die in the West
programme.desc: Mild-mannered sheep farmer Albert Stark (Seth MacFarlane) feels certain that the Western frontier is trying to kill him, then he loses his girlfriend, Louise (Amanda Seyfried), to the town's most successful businessman. However, a beautiful, pistol-packing woman named Anna (Charlize Theron) rides into town and helps Albert find his inner courage. Then Stark must put his newfound bravery to the test when Anna's outlaw husband arrives with plans to plant him in an unmarked grave.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: When the first outbreak of the Reaper virus hit Scotland, Eden Sinclair was one of the last to escape containment and had to leave her mother behind. Twenty-five years later, Maj. Eden Sinclair (Rhona Mitra) leads a team back into the hot zone to find a counteragent to the virus, which has re-emerged in London. She and her comrades wage a desperate battle for survival against feral survivors, as they try to prevent it from ushering in a new dark age.

programme.title: The Purge: Anarchy
programme.desc: One night per year, the government sanctions a 12-hour period in which citizens can commit any crime they wish -- including murder -- without fear of punishment or imprisonment. Leo, a sergeant who lost his son, plans a vigilante mission of revenge during the mayhem. However, instead of a death-dealing avenger, he becomes the unexpected protector of four innocent strangers who desperately need his help if they are to survive the night.

programme.desc: Five ordinary teens must become something extraordinary when they learn that their small town of Angel Grove - and the world - is on the verge of being obliterated by an alien threat. Chosen by destiny, our heroes quickly discover they are the only ones who can save the planet. But to do so, they will have to overcome their real-life issues and, before it's too late, band together as the Power Rangers.

programme.title: Borderlands
programme.desc: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets.

programme.title: Latency
programme.desc: An agoraphobic gamer agrees to test new equipment that uses AI to interpret the electrical activity of her brain. Soon, the line between reality and her subconscious starts to blur as she wonders if the device is serving a sinister force.

programme.title: Mindcage
programme.desc: When a copycat murderer strikes, Detectives Jake Doyle and Mary Kelly seek help from an incarcerated serial killer called the Artist. As Mary delves deep into the Artist's brilliant but twisted psyche, she and Jake get lured into a diabolical game of cat and mouse, racing against time to stay one step ahead of both criminals.

programme.title: Escape the Field
programme.desc: Stripped of their possessions, six strangers wake up in a remote, endless cornfield with six items -- a gun with a single bullet, matches, a lantern, a knife, a compass and a flask of water. As mysterious sirens blare in the distance and traps appear at every turn, they soon realize they're in a mysterious cat-and-mouse game with an unseen evil, and survival depends upon solving a diabolical and deadly puzzle.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: After returning home to England, aristocrat Robin of Loxley learns that the evil Sheriff of Nottingham has seized his family estate. He soon joins forces with Friar Tuck and Little John -- a fierce Arabian warrior who wants to put an end to the Crusades. Armed with arrows and dubbed Robin Hood, Loxley leads a band of oppressed rebels in a daring plan to rob the Sheriff of his money and take away his power.

programme.title: Stronger
programme.desc: Jeff Bauman loses both of his legs when two bombs explode during the Boston Marathon on April 15, 2013. After regaining consciousness in the hospital, Jeff is able to help law enforcement identify one of the suspects, but his own battle is just beginning. With unwavering support from his family and girlfriend, Bauman embarks on a long and heroic journey to physical and emotional rehabilitation.

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon
programme.desc: On April 20, 2010, the Deepwater Horizon drilling rig explodes in the Gulf of Mexico, igniting a massive fireball that kills several crew members. Chief electronics technician Mike Williams (Mark Wahlberg) and his colleagues find themselves fighting for survival as the heat and the flames become stifling and overwhelming. Banding together, the co-workers must use their wits to make it out alive amid all the chaos.

programme.title: The Next Three Days
programme.desc: Life for John and Lara Brennan (Russell Crowe, Elizabeth Banks) is miserable after she is convicted of a murder she says she did not commit. Three years later while struggling with the demands of work and raising his son alone, John is still trying to establish her innocence. When her final appeal is rejected, Lara becomes suicidal, forcing John to exercise the only option he has left: Break her out of prison.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

programme.title: Rocky IV
programme.desc: East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

programme.title: Creed II
programme.desc: The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

programme.title: Creed III
programme.desc: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life. But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.sub-title: Just How Sporty Are You? Everything is Fluctuating!

programme.sub-title: Sharpen Your Mind!! The Newly Awakened Powers of the Magical Girl

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door

programme.sub-title: A Town Full of Traps? The Demon on the Brink Awakens a New Ability

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door

programme.sub-title: Courage to Face the Future!! The Heavy Roller Won't Stop

programme.sub-title: The Pink Method!! The Wheel of Fate is a Round Tire!!

programme.sub-title: The Cursed Fruit!! Beware the Sour Mikan!!

programme.sub-title: Final Exams!! Today I'm One of Those Brainy Demons!!

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door

programme.sub-title: The Ancestor Evolves!! A Pair of Glasses Reflect Within a Dark Lab

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door

programme.sub-title: Diving into Dreams Once Again!! Break Through the Pink Defense Line

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Momo needs to process the shocking revelations that rocked her to the core! Perhaps Yuko can solve the dilemma by offering Momo a deal with a demon girl.
programme.sub-title: Feelings to Convey!! A New Leap Forward for Demonkind!!

programme.title: Maid-Sama!
programme.desc: Takumi narrates a strange retelling of the legend of Momotaro with Misaki as the titular character herself.

programme.sub-title: The Secret of Takumi Usui Approaches!

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Early on in babies' development, they begin to recognize primary colors such as blue, red, and yellow. programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: From the moment babies are born, they use their developing senses to discover the world. programme.title: Baby Einstein

programme.title: The Sandbox

programme.title: Manners Manor
programme.desc: Introducing "Manners Manor," a new series from Baby Einstein. Designed to help your child learn all about manners in a fun and thoughtful way. The content is based on "The Einstein Way" - a curiosity-driven learning philosophy, from industry experts, inspired by Montessori and STEAM. It also reflects our core belief that curiosity is the most important skill for our kids to learn in order to be successful and adaptable in an ever-changing world.

programme.title: Baby Einstein

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: My First Signs: See and Sign With Baby

programme.title: Baby Einstein

programme.title: Baby Einstein

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Journey to the classroom with your favorite Baby Einstein friends! programme.title: No Blueberry Is an Island

Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does, so they can prepare accordingly—they see Strawberry wearing a diving mask and snorkel in the cafe, and race to the lake to practice scuba diving, not knowing she was only slicing onions.

programme.title: Where the Berry Breeze Blows
programme.desc: It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here! She insists they can build a copy of “Berry Breezy Bay” resort on Berry Bitty Lake, a duplicate down to the last detail.

programme.title: Sid's Rainy Day Play Date

programme.title: Special Sunny Dad Day
programme.desc: At school, Sid and his friends discover that sunblock is a great way to protect your skin from the sun. And they also learn about the amazing ways the sun helps the Earth.

programme.title: Tarzan and Jane
